## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS 11 or later (Apple Silicon and Intel) | `Libre.Calculator_*_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 (x64) | `*_x64-setup.exe` or `*_x64_en-US.msi` |
| Windows on ARM | `*_arm64-setup.exe` |
| Debian, Ubuntu | `*_amd64.deb` or `*_arm64.deb` |
| Fedora, openSUSE, RHEL | `*.x86_64.rpm` or `*.aarch64.rpm` |
| Any Linux | `*_amd64.AppImage` or `*_aarch64.AppImage` |

`SHA256SUMS.txt` lists a checksum for every file.

These builds are not yet signed by Apple or Microsoft, so your system will warn you the first time:

- **macOS:** open the app once, then go to System Settings › Privacy & Security and choose **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** on the SmartScreen prompt, choose **More info › Run anyway**.
- **AppImage:** make the file executable (`chmod +x`) and run it.
